notes: τοῖς δούλοις σου: the article is unrepresented under rule 20 and the case preposition unto stays with the noun, rule 21 forbidding a bare unto on the article.
ἔπιδε ἐπί: the expressed preposition answers to the ἐπι- preverb, so upon is its own and the compound verb keeps only look (rules 36, 106).
